name: Unstyled frontal snapshot
summary: A photograph that hides its own styling: the subject faces the camera in flat daylight, with no prop, no filter and no pose.
how: Place the camera at eye height, 1.5m to 2m from the subject.
Shoot in open shade or overcast daylight, with no flash.
Centre the subject and keep a neutral wall or a plain street behind it.
Do not apply a filter, a vignette or a grade beyond a white balance.

origin.note: Normcore feeds and posts show ordinary clothes in plain snapshots.

adoptions.via: Normcore catalogues and feeds show clothes and people in flat daylight, front-on, with no filter and no props.
